Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026-10-01.

What we collect

Nothing that identifies you. There is no account system, no login, no newsletter and no form that sends your input anywhere.

Where your input goes

Every calculation, conversion and formatting operation is executed by JavaScript already running in your browser tab. Values you type are never transmitted to a server — they exist only in your device's memory and disappear when you close or reload the page.

Cookies

ToolFactory sets no cookies of its own and no tracking pixels. There is no consent banner because there is nothing to consent to.

Analytics

We look at simple aggregate page-view counts to tell which tools are actually used. These statistics are cookie-free, do not create a profile of you, do not follow you across sites and are not linked to any identifier.

Advertising

The site currently shows no third-party advertising. If advertising is added later, this page will be updated first, and any ad provider will be limited to tools-independent placements.

Third-party links

Some pages link to external resources for reference. Once you leave ToolFactory, the destination site's own privacy policy applies.

Children

The site is not directed at children under 13 and collects no personal information from anyone.

Your rights

Because we hold no personal data about you, there is nothing to export or delete on request. If you believe otherwise, contact us and we will look into it.

Changes

Any material change to this policy will be published on this page with a new date.
